note: Round 2 of the practice figures (2026-11-02). Burooj on round 1: varied grounds stay; abstract, quiet, graceful motion on a ~10 s breath; no human silhouettes. Each practice has two or three variants (figure + ground); `was` is round 1's tile for comparison (the shared tile for the two splits). `pick` is the variant I'd ship.

practices.name: Insight Dialogue
practices.desc: Meditating together, in conversation: pause, relax, open, and listen deeply.

was.why: Two plain circles: too literal and flat.

practices.name: Noting
practices.desc: Lightly labelling each experience as it comes: rising, falling, hearing, thinking.

practices.name: Effortless mindfulness
practices.desc: Short glimpses of the awake awareness that is already here.

practices.name: Kāyagatāsati
practices.desc: Mindfulness of the body, from the breath and posture to a slow scan.

practices.name: Prāṇa · Qì
practices.desc: Sensing the body as a field of energy, and letting it open.

practices.name: Focusing
practices.desc: Listening to the body's felt sense of a situation until it shifts.

practices.name: Yoga nidrā
practices.desc: Guided deep rest, aware between waking and sleep.

practices.name: Headless Way
practices.desc: Looking back at where your head should be, and finding open space.

was.why: A human outline (the idea, an open space where the head should be, stays).

practices.name: Dzogchen
practices.desc: Resting as the mind's own nature: open, clear and spontaneously present.

practices.name: Mahāmudrā
practices.desc: The great seal: recognising mind in whatever arises.

practices.name: Trāṭaka
practices.desc: Gazing at one flame or point without blinking, then holding its afterimage within.

practices.name: Kasiṇa
practices.desc: Gazing at a device, a disc of earth, water, fire or colour, until its sign leads into jhāna.

fixes.label: Zazen · fixed
fixes.what: The ensō's thin tail was under a pixel at tile size, so the still read as a crescent moon. The tail keeps a visible minimum width now.

fixes.label: Open awareness · fixed
fixes.what: Same fault as Effortless mindfulness: hard-edged dark ellipses read as rocks. The clouds are soft, light veils now.
